mission: Advance a broad non-P0 swarm through existing Home Center/GitHub owners only.

fronts.name: backend-result-schema-custody
fronts.intent: Require the admitted backend result to identify the canonical custody schema before authority evidence is interpreted.

fronts.name: authority-group-membership-custody
fronts.intent: Require every authority-group promotion member to be present in the admitted surgeries inventory; reject phantom promotion evidence.

fronts.name: hostile-regression-source
fronts.intent: Pin schema drift, phantom group members, malformed surgeries, duplicate surgery identity, and group-to-inventory membership. Regression execution remains separate.

fronts.name: durable-skill-convergence
fronts.intent: Make schema custody and surgery-inventory membership part of durable backend-admission doctrine.

fronts.name: touchable-warm-wall
fronts.intent: Expose schema and phantom-member gates as non-raster, keyboard/touch-inspectable SOURCE ONLY states without claiming runtime delivery.

requiredReviews.sheRaw: attempted pre-execution; account connection HTTP 400; no substitute verdict
requiredReviews.regnet: code-first bounded source review after mutation
requiredReviews.venice: same-worker bounded completion gate; no merge/runtime promotion

capabilityBoundary: Repository/source artifacts may advance; regression execution, TESTED, runtime UI/TalkBack, deployment, phone callability/execution, delivery, and acceptance remain separate gates.
